raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for a base model, Mistralv0.2-Base, and for the same model fine-tuned on six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents "Negative log probability" on a linear scale ranging from -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The horizontal axis lists the six medical specialties as categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," and the bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each specialty. Each group contains seven bars: one light blue bar representing the base model (Mistralv0.2-Base), and six colored bars (light orange to dark brown) representing the model fine-tuned on each of the six specialties. The legend indicates the color coding for the fine-tuned models: light orange for Cardio, slightly darker orange for Gastro, medium orange for Infect, darker orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. Within each specialty group, the bars are ordered from left to right as: base model, then fine-tuned models in the order listed in the legend. The base model's bar is consistently the shortest (highest negative log probability, indicating lower performance) in each group, while the fine-tuned models show varying lengths, with the bar corresponding to the specialty on which the model was fine-tuned typically being the longest (lowest negative log probability, indicating higher performance). For example, in the "Cardio" group, the dark brown bar (Pediatrics fine-tuned) is the shortest among fine-tuned models, while the light orange bar (Cardio fine-tuned) is the longest. The bars are not sorted by height; they are grouped by specialty and ordered by the legend's sequence within each group. There is no visual emphasis (e.g., shading or annotations) on any specific bar.
